purpose: Supervised eBay listing preparation inside the Aegis VM browser while API access is pending or intentionally avoided.

developer_api_setup.operator_note: Use the VM developer portal only for human-visible setup and consent. Do not log client secrets, OAuth tokens, cookies, payment settings, payout settings, or account-security fields.

login_persistence.operator_note: The operator should sign in inside the Aegis VM Chrome window and use browser save/remember prompts as desired. Do not copy credentials into chat, markdown, logs, screenshots, or RAG.
evidence_without_secret_values: eBay sign-in page loaded in the Aegis VM on Chrome CDP port 9234.
Aegis profile_slug=ebay resolves to the persistent Apollo eBay profile.

allowed: Open the eBay sell flow in the Aegis VM browser.
Use Apollo prepared review packets to fill draft listing fields.
Attach or upload operator-approved item images.
Capture evidence screenshots and field summaries for human review.
Pause for the operator at pricing, shipping, return, fee, warning, and final publish/list screens.
blocked: Clicking final Publish, List, Submit, Confirm, or equivalent live listing buttons.
Changing account security, payout, tax, bank, or identity settings.
Reading, exporting, logging, or storing credentials, cookies, OAuth tokens, or payment details.
Using the native desktop browser unless the operator explicitly requests native desktop execution.

publish_api_gates: I approve Apollo listing this item on eBay
